{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to float after stripping commas
if df['revenue'].dtype != 'object':
    df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].astype(str)
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH (include all statuses, including refunded)
filtered_df = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Compute and print the number of rows in the filtered dataset (all NEW paid_search customers)
print("Total number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH (including refunded):")
print(len(filtered_df))

# Compute and print the number of converted orders in that group
print("Number of converted orders among NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH:")
print(filtered_df['converted'].sum())

# Compute and print the conversion rate
conversion_rate = filtered_df['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rate:")
print(conversion_rate)"}
